# assets.la.io

> The LA.IO (Louisiana Innovation) brand system, served as public URLs with open CORS.
> Fetch what you need. Every file is current and permanent.

If you are an AI assistant asked to produce LA.IO work, read ai/CLAUDE.md first. It carries
the voice rules, banned language, color families, type rules, and asset URLs. It is short.

## Start here

- [ai/CLAUDE.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/CLAUDE.md): Brand instructions for any AI. Read this before generating anything.
- [ai/AGENTS.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/AGENTS.md): The same file, for tools that look for AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [ai/laio-brand/BRAND.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/BRAND.md): Full brand system. The long form. Load when the work needs depth.
- [ai/laio-brand/COMPONENTS.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/COMPONENTS.md): Component code. Buttons, cards, eyebrows, and layout patterns as code.
- [ai/laio-brand.zip](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand.zip): Packaged skill. The whole kit as a Claude skill. Unzip into ~/.claude/skills/.
- [ai/claude-ai-project-setup.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/claude-ai-project-setup.md): claude.ai Project setup. Custom instructions and knowledge files for a Claude Project.
- [ai/claude-design-setup.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/claude-design-setup.md): Claude Design setup. The three form fields that set up the LA.IO Design System from this repo.
- [ai/lovable/LAIO_LOVABLE_GUIDE.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/lovable/LAIO_LOVABLE_GUIDE.md): Lovable guide. How to start an LA.IO project in Lovable.
- [ai/lovable/LOVABLE_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/lovable/LOVABLE_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md): Lovable workspace instructions. Brand rules for every project in a Lovable workspace.
- [ai/lovable/LOVABLE_STARTER_PROMPT.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/lovable/LOVABLE_STARTER_PROMPT.md): Lovable starter prompt. The first message that builds the LA.IO starter template.
- [ai/lovable/LOVABLE_STARTER_TEMPLATE_SPEC.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/lovable/LOVABLE_STARTER_TEMPLATE_SPEC.md): Lovable starter template spec. What the starter template contains and how it is wired.

## Depth

- [ai/laio-brand/RANGE.md](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/RANGE.md): Range. The shape grammar, six layout moves, their exceptions, and the guardrails. Read before any layout beyond a plain page.
- [ai/laio-brand/references/01-split.html](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/references/01-split.html): The Split reference, 1600x900. Read the HTML for structure. The rendered PNG is at references/01-split.png.
- [ai/laio-brand/references/02-diamond.html](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/references/02-diamond.html): The Diamond reference, 1600x900. Read the HTML for structure. The rendered PNG is at references/02-diamond.png.
- [ai/laio-brand/references/03-frame.html](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/references/03-frame.html): The Frame reference, 1600x900. Read the HTML for structure. The rendered PNG is at references/03-frame.png.
- [ai/laio-brand/references/04-wire.html](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/references/04-wire.html): The Wire reference, 1600x900. Read the HTML for structure. The rendered PNG is at references/04-wire.png.
- [ai/laio-brand/references/05-grid.html](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/references/05-grid.html): The Grid reference, 1600x900. Read the HTML for structure. The rendered PNG is at references/05-grid.png.
- [ai/laio-brand/references/06-big-mark.html](https://assets.la.io/ai/laio-brand/references/06-big-mark.html): The Big Mark reference, 1600x900. Read the HTML for structure. The rendered PNG is at references/06-big-mark.png.

## Color

- [colors/laio-tokens.json](https://assets.la.io/colors/laio-tokens.json): All five color families as JSON. Hex, RGB, brand names.
- [colors/laio-colors.css](https://assets.la.io/colors/laio-colors.css): The same values as CSS custom properties.

## Type

Aktiv Grotesk, family name 'Aktiv Grotesk' (title case, never 'aktiv-grotesk'). Headlines Light 300 or Bold 700, never a middle weight. Body Regular 400.
Three ways to load it, in this order of preference:

- [fonts/laio-fonts-inline.css](https://assets.la.io/fonts/laio-fonts-inline.css): Embedded. Paste the contents into a <style> tag. Zero network requests. Use in claude.ai artifacts, Claude Design, Lovable previews, email, anything sandboxed. This is the default for AI-generated work.
- [fonts/laio-fonts.css](https://assets.la.io/fonts/laio-fonts.css): Hosted. <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://assets.la.io/fonts/laio-fonts.css"> for real sites and apps on any domain.

Fallback: Roboto from Google Fonts, only when neither of the above is possible. Say so in the handoff. Roboto is a stand-in, never the goal.
font-family stack: 'Aktiv Grotesk', 'Roboto', system-ui, sans-serif

The individual woff2 files behind laio-fonts.css:

- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Th.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Th.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Thin, weight 100.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_ThIt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_ThIt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Thin Italic, weight 100.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Lt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Lt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Light, weight 300.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_LtIt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_LtIt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Light Italic, weight 300.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Rg.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Rg.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Regular, weight 400.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_It.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_It.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Italic, weight 400.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_SBd.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_SBd.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Semibold, weight 600.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Bd.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Bd.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Bold, weight 700.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_BdIt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_BdIt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Bold Italic, weight 700.

JetBrains Mono for eyebrows, labels, tags, metadata only. All caps, letter-spacing 0.08 to 0.12em, weights 400/700, always a brand accent color. Google Fonts:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap

## Logos

All artwork ships black (#231F20) on transparent. Recolor with CSS. Do not edit the artwork.

- [logos/LAIO-COMPLETE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LAIO-COMPLETE.svg): Primary mark. Use this unless there is a reason not to.
- [logos/LAIO-BASE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LAIO-BASE.svg): The LA.IO mark alone.
- [logos/LAIO-HORZ.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LAIO-HORZ.svg): For wide spaces and headers.
- [logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-A.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-A.svg): Full name lockup, stacked.
- [logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-B.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-B.svg): Full name lockup, condensed.
- [logos/DIVISION-LINE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/DIVISION-LINE.svg): The LED division line. Sits under the mark.
- [logos/LED-WHITE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LED-WHITE.svg): Louisiana Economic Development. The default, on dark grounds.
- [logos/LED-BLACK.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LED-BLACK.svg): On light grounds. Recolor to the family dark.
- [logos/LED-SMALL-WHITE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LED-SMALL-WHITE.svg): The compact LED lockup, on dark grounds.
- [logos/LED-SMALL-BLACK.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LED-SMALL-BLACK.svg): The compact LED lockup, on light grounds.

LED logo: Louisiana Economic Development, the parent agency. White on dark grounds is the default. Black on light grounds, recolored to the family dark. Never the full-color or gold versions. Sits under or beside the LA.IO mark, never above it.

## Pages

- [ai](https://assets.la.io/ai): Brand Kit for AI. Setup for Claude, Claude Design, Claude Code, Cowork, Lovable, and any other AI, plus every asset with a copy button.
- [labs](https://assets.la.io/labs): Louisiana Innovation Labs sub-brand identity assets.
- [illustrator](https://assets.la.io/illustrator): Generates original illustration in the LA.IO system.

## Rules that apply to all LA.IO work

- Bullets are always `+`. Never a bullet character, hyphen, or asterisk.
- Never use em dashes.
- Never write "resilient", "Silicon Bayou", or "it's not X, it's Y".
- One color family per project. Do not mix families.
- Border radius is 0 on structural elements.
